record.name: Branislav Lekić
record.title: Research Associate
record.bio: Branislav Lekić completed his BSc and MSc in Geodesy and Geoinformatics at the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad, graduating in 2014 and 2016 respectively. He received his PhD from the same institution in 2022, with a dissertation on parcel-level crop yield estimation using dense Sentinel-2 time series fused with meteorological reanalysis data. He joined the Remote Sensing and GIS Group at the BioSense Institute as a Research Associate in 2022, where the group focuses on satellite-based agricultural monitoring, land-cover mapping, and precision farming decision support. He contributed to teaching exercises in the GIS and Remote Sensing courses at the Faculty of Technical Sciences. His experimental work relies on the group's high-performance computing cluster, Google Earth Engine, and ground-truth yield data collected via collaboration with local agricultural cooperatives.
record.industry_experience: During the CROPSENSE project Lekić worked directly with staff from three agricultural cooperatives to collect combine-harvester yield records and validate satellite-based estimates, gaining practical experience in translating research outputs into formats usable by field agronomists.
record.notes: Left the University of Novi Sad in March 2026; now a postdoctoral researcher at a university in Austria. Profile not updated. Enquiries regarding ongoing collaboration or access to the CROPSENSE dataset should be directed to the Remote Sensing and GIS Group at BioSense Institute.
